# Ojasio AI Discovery Manifest

## Core Principles
Ojasio is India's premium virtual space for scientifically-driven, culturally-adapted nutrition consulting by Disha Arora.
Key focuses: Sustainable Weight Management, PCOS Reversal, Diabetes Nutrition, Hashimoto's & Hypothyroidism.
